mexico-2019.notes: Both sources are of the 2019 Latin American regional problem set; the PDF cover lists México among the host countries and gives November 8th-9th, 2019 (a span, so no contest date taken; the catalogue has 2019-11-09). The saved PDF file is named page.html.

sources.evidence: PDF whose cover reads '2019 Latin American Regional Contests, November 8th-9th, 2019' and lists México among the host countries, with problems A to M matching the catalogue titles.
QOJ contest page 'The 2019 ICPC Latin America Regional Contest' listing problems A to M with the catalogue's titles; the page does not name Mexico.

mexico-2021.notes: Source 7 (omegaUp ICPCMX2021) is the contest entry page behind a login (name, time and rules only, no problems), so it is set to not-the-document; a capture of the 11 public problems (alias prefix ICPCMX2021-) would be needed. The PDF (source 4) file is named page.html.

mexico-2023.notes: The QOJ contest is named 'The 2023 ICPC Latin America Regional Contest'; its 13 problems match this contest's catalogue list. Nothing on the page names the Mexico Finals.
